from: August book, night 25 (The Lord Is My Shepherd)
p1: Before David was king, he took care of his father’s sheep. Later he wrote a song: “The Lord is my shepherd.”
David sang, “He makes me lie down in green pastures.” Those are the soft grassy fields where sheep eat and rest.
He sang, “He leads me beside the still waters.” Fast water can sweep a little sheep away. So a good shepherd finds calm water for them to drink.
p2: David sang, “I will not be afraid, for You are with me.” A shepherd’s strong sticks kept the sheep safe from wild animals. Many years later, Jesus said, “I am the good shepherd.”
You are one of Jesus’s little lambs. Tonight, snuggle down like a sheep in soft grass, safe with your Shepherd.
old: A shepherd boy named David wrote one of the most beautiful songs of all. He knew all about sheep and how a good shepherd takes care of them.
“The Lord is my shepherd,” David sang. “He leads me to soft green grass and cool, quiet water. He helps me rest.”
David knew that Heavenly Father cares for us just like a shepherd cares for his little lambs. He leads us, feeds us, and keeps us safe.
“Even in the dark, I will not be afraid,” David sang, “because Heavenly Father is with me.” When we feel scared, we can remember: our good Shepherd is always right beside us.
